title: Christmas Past
intro: A few moments from our family Christmases.
quote: The best part of Christmas has always been who's around the table.

memories.title: A seat at our table
memories.alt: The family Christmas table set with gold plates, crystal glasses and Christmas crackers, with AJ in a Santa hat beside the tree.

memories.title: A little Christmas mischief
memories.alt: Santa smiling as he holds a laughing AJ upside down across his lap.

memories.title: Christmas sweaters, all together
memories.alt: A large family group gathered in Christmas sweaters, with Roger among them.

memories.title: A little winter wonder
memories.alt: AJ with his arms raised in front of a towering outdoor Christmas tree in a snowy scene.

memories.title: A Christmas toast
memories.alt: Family members gathered around the Christmas dinner table, raising their glasses together, with AJ smiling in the foreground.

memories.title: Trimming the tree
memories.alt: AJ and an older family member hanging an ornament on the Christmas tree together.

memories.title: Christmas dinner, together
memories.alt: The family gathered around the Christmas dinner table, smiling toward the camera, with AJ in a Santa hat in the foreground.

memories.title: Christmas morning, together
memories.alt: Andrew, Cait, AJ and another family member smiling together in matching holiday clothes beside Christmas gifts.

memories.title: Matching Christmas plaid
memories.alt: Cait holding baby AJ beside the Christmas tree, both wearing matching red and black plaid.

memories.title: Roger by the tree
memories.alt: Roger resting on the sofa beside the lit Christmas tree, wearing a red and black plaid bandana.
